metadata.title: Regression: question order fixed across refresh
metadata.description: Enketo spike workaround 1 (E4/E5; runtime-design §3): item and choice orders are realised at first reach and stored before the page renders, so a refresh before any answer, a resume, and a back then refresh never re-roll them.

metadata.title: Regression: irrelevant values cleared on page change
metadata.description: Enketo spike workaround 2 (E8, P5c): a value hidden on its own page is cleared on that page's submit, stays cleared across refresh and resume, and does not come back when it is shown again.

metadata.title: Regression: server-side resume
metadata.description: Enketo spike workaround 3 (E7, P6): with no local copy (storage blocked, R-1) every answer is saved to the server, and refresh and resume restore page and values from the server alone.

metadata.description: runtime-design §7a, R-7: $trial counts pages actually shown on the participant's path (a skipped empty block, a failed submit, a refresh and back-then-next do not add to it); $position is the place within the enclosing randomiser.

metadata.title: Branch path changes after back
metadata.description: C3a-6 (open): going back and changing an answer so that a branch no longer leads to a block that was already answered. Draft traces; the abandoned block's states and values are pending.

metadata.title: Back-and-change empties a visited block
metadata.description: §3/§4/§6: after back, a change makes an already answered block empty: its values are cleared, it is skipped on next and on back, a later required question becomes relevant, and the block returns empty when relevant again.

metadata.title: Refresh after an unsubmitted change
metadata.description: §3/§5: clearing happens on page submit, and a refresh is not a submit. An unsubmitted change that would hide a later answer survives refresh, but the later answer is not cleared until the change is submitted.

metadata.title: Constraint broken by a back-and-change
metadata.description: §4: lowering an earlier answer makes a later, already accepted answer violate its constraint. The value is kept (answered) until its page is submitted again, which then fails until it is fixed.

content.text: planning/rich-text.md §3 (task RT2): the rich-text model end to end. Block fields (a note, the consent text, the end message) carry headings and lists; stems (labels, help) carry marks, links and pipes; inline fields (choice, row and column labels, slider end labels, the page title, the constraint message, the consent buttons) carry one paragraph. Pipes sit inside formatting. Arabic is a second language with a rich RTL label; one label has no Arabic and falls back.
